data_fields.donor_constant: added per level above 1 (file-defined; not in box)

data_fields.name: xp_scaling_multipliers
data_fields.donor_constant: absolute by enemy level, relative by level gap (file tables, not in box)

best_idea: One function builds every derived stat from level, spent points and summed bonuses, in a fixed order, with a floor, so a character sheet and a fight read the same numbers.
decision_why: The stack (level and points, then additive and multiplicative bonuses, then a floor) is the simplest honest way to get derived stats from attributes; keep whole-point primaries and our names.
acceptance: A server test computes HP for level 3 with 3 physical points, starting 10, per-level 2, per-physical 4, +5 additive and x1.5 multiplicative, and expects 40.5; the character sheet shows the same number the duel uses.
